While both models are capable, Dunlin shows stronger performance on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7) and across all internal evals generally. This is an open-ended creative generation task asking for original framework development with explicit latitude ("pick five or six," "name them however you like," "surprise me"). Dunlin shows stronger capability across creative generation and general task performance (84.7 vs 82.7 on Creative Generation; 90.6 vs 83.2 on Arena-Hard). Willet self-reports aversion to high-latitude generative work, and while its capability isn't diminished, Dunlin is the better fit for a task explicitly designed to reward originality and creative framing.
